actions.description: Fill mold with powder from the trickler while holding a mold without its top piston at the scale.
Pick up a mold from a mold slot.
Place a mold into a mold slot.
Retrieve a piston from the dispenser and insert into mold. Requires manipulator tool, mold without top piston, and must start from the corresponding dispenser ready position.

Tamp the powder contents of a mold held by the manipulator to reduce volume. Used before inserting top piston to: (1) allow the piston to fit if powder volume is too high, and (2) reduce airborne powder when inserting the piston. Typically performed at scale_ready position.
Home all axes (X, Y, Z, U). Can be conducted from any position (typical), but requires no tool picked up and no mold. Returns machine to global_ready position.
Home the manipulator axis (V). Requires no mold picked up.
Home the trickler axis (W). Can be homed at any time with no requirements.

Pick up a supported tool and return to global_ready position. Valid only from global_ready position. Requires no tool already picked up and mold_transfer_safe z_height. The tool's default offset is loaded by the state machine AFTER arrival at global_ready, so this action runs under the manipulator (zero) offset.

Park the active supported tool and return to global_ready position. Valid from global_ready position. The state machine restores the manipulator (zero) offset BEFORE invoking this action so the park always runs under the reference frame.

Perform the hardness tester action at the current computed sample position. The action may transiently switch the active tool offset to 'durometer_z_probe' for z-probing, but must restore the 'durometer' offset before returning.
Actuate the hardness tester power button servo. Allowed at any position.
Actuate the hardness tester power button servo. Allowed at any position.
Actuate the hardness tester zero button servo. Allowed at any position.
Place a held mold onto the scale. Must be at scale_ready position with manipulator tool holding a mold without top piston.
Pick up a mold from the scale. Must be at scale_active position with manipulator tool engaged and mold on scale.
Open the powder dispenser cover. Requires manipulator tool to be active, a mold to be placed on the scale, and the tool to be engaged at scale_active.
Close the powder dispenser cover. Requires manipulator tool to be active, a mold to be placed on the scale, and the tool to be engaged at scale_active.
